module Test.FeatureIntegration.Pos

-- FEAT-01: Range types
type Percentage is Integer range 0..100
type Score is Double range 0.0..10.0

-- FEAT-02: Records with proto field ids
type UserProfile is record
    user_id: Integer proto 1
    username: String proto 2
    is_staff: Boolean proto 3
end record

-- FEAT-08: Generic type arguments
type Container<T> is record
    item: T
    checksum: BigInteger
end record

error ValidationError
error ExecutionError

-- FEAT-06: gRPC service IDL surface
service UserDeliveryService is
    rpc FetchProfile(request: UserProfile): UserProfile
end UserDeliveryService

-- FEAT-03 and FEAT-07: contracts plus abort declaration/body
function process_percentage(input: Integer) returns Percentage
requires input >= 0, input <= 100
aborts ValidationError
ensures result = input
is
    if input < 0 or input > 100 then
        abort ValidationError
    end if
    return input
end process_percentage

-- FEAT-04: loop invariants and variant
function sum_up_to(max: Integer) returns Integer
requires max > 0
ensures result >= max
is
    let current: Integer = 0
    let total: Integer = 0

    while current < max
    invariant current >= 0
    invariant current <= max
    invariant total >= current
    variant max - current
    do
        current := current + 1
        total := total + current
    end while

    return total
end sum_up_to

-- FEAT-05: structured concurrency Scope block
async function async_fetch_data() returns String
is
    return "Data"
end async_fetch_data

async function run_concurrent_tasks() returns String
is
    scope test_scope do
        spawn
            let handle: JoinHandle<String> = test_scope.spawn<String>(async_fetch_data())
        join
            let data: String = await test_scope.join<String>(handle)
        result
            return data
    end scope
end run_concurrent_tasks

-- FEAT-08: Result<Array<T,N>, E> type arguments in routine surface
function load_scores() returns Result<Array<Integer, 3>, ExecutionError>
ensures success, value[0] >= 0
is
    return ok [90, 95, 100]
end load_scores

procedure main()
aborts ValidationError
is
    let scores: Array<Integer, 3> = [90, 95, 100]
    let first_score: Integer = scores[0]
    check first_score = 90

    let profile: UserProfile = UserProfile {
        user_id: 42,
        username: "Johann",
        is_staff: true
    }

    check profile.user_id = 42
    check profile.is_staff = true

    let valid_pct: Percentage = process_percentage(50)
    check valid_pct = 50

    let calculated_sum: Integer = sum_up_to(10)
    check calculated_sum >= 10

    call Std.IO.logf("All positive integration tests passed successfully.")
end main

end Test.FeatureIntegration.Pos
